title: fix: remove outdated quest news announcement
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the outdated “More ways to earn Pollen” card from the news page.
- Leaves quest definitions and rewards unchanged.

Fixes #15552

gist.headline: Old news, neatly filed
gist.blurb: The news page has put away its outdated “More ways to earn Pollen” card. Quests and their rewards are right where they were.
gist.summary: Removed the outdated “More ways to earn Pollen” card from the news page while leaving Quest definitions and rewards unchanged.
gist.impact: Visitors get a more current news page; available Quests and their rewards are unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the pollinations.ai news page as a cozy garden noticeboard. Polli, wearing a tiny newsboy cap, files an old announcement card while Quest flowers and reward tokens remain undisturbed.
gist.image_prompt: At a cozy pixel-art garden noticeboard, Polli in a tiny newsboy cap gently files an old news card beside blooming Quest flowers and untouched Pollen reward tokens; she is a small, cute pixel art bee with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream surroundings, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
